title: SATFRONT: Detecting Atmospheric Fronts with Satellite Data using Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.42111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Atmospheric fronts are associated with much of the high-impact weather in the mid-latitudes, yet their identification and classification remain largely manual and subjective. Existing deep learning approaches rely primarily on gridded reanalysis or forecast data, limiting their applicability to satellite observations available for time-critical applications. We introduce SATFRONT, a machine learning framework for detecting cold, warm, and occluded fronts over Europe from geostationary satellite observations, with reanalysis data as an optional additional input. The model is trained on frontal analyses from five European national meteorological services and evaluated against UK Met Office analyses for 2024. translated_title: SATFRONT：利用机器学习从卫星数据中检测大气锋面
translated_abstract: 大气锋面与中纬度地区许多高影响天气密切相关，但锋面的识别和分类在很大程度上仍依赖人工且带有主观性。现有的深度学习方法主要依赖网格化的再分析或预报数据，这限制了它们对卫星观测数据的应用，而卫星观测对于时间关键型应用至关重要。我们提出了SATFRONT，这是一个机器学习框架，用于从地球静止卫星观测数据中检测欧洲地区的冷锋、暖锋和锢囚锋，再分析数据可作为可选的额外输入。该模型基于五个欧洲国家气象部门的锋面分析数据进行训练，并针对英国气象局2024年的分析数据进行了评估。仅使用卫星观测数据，SATFRONT在150公里容差范围内达到了0.428的临界成功指数（CSI），处于不同气象部门分析结果之间的一致性范围内（0.277-0.501），并且高于...
tldr: 提出SATFRONT机器学习框架，仅利用地球静止卫星观测数据即可检测欧洲地区的冷锋、暖锋和锢囚锋，其性能达到不同气象部门人工分析之间的一致性水平，适用于时间关键型业务应用。
en_tdlr: SATFRONT is a machine learning framework that detects cold, warm, and occluded fronts over Europe using only geostationary satellite observations, achieving performance within the range of agreement between different meteorological services' manual analyses.
